title: Cylindrical body
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the X Y plane, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a single circle centered at coordinates (0.0277, 0.0277) with a radius of 0.0277. Scale this sketch by a factor of 0.0554. Ensure that the scaled sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by rotating it using Euler angles of zero degrees and translating it with a vector of zero. Extrude the scaled sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to form a solid cylindrical body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical body will be 0.05541176470588235 units in length, 0.05541176470588235 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the pen
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0277, 0.0277)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0277)          # Draw a circle with the given radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the pen body
pen_body = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)           # Extrude the circle to create the cylindrical body
)

# Create the pointed tip
tip = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0277, 0.0277)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0277)          # Draw a circle with the same radius as the base
    .extrude(0.0554)         # Extrude the circle to create a smaller cylinder for the tip
    .faces(">Z")             # Select the top face of the smaller cylinder
    .workplane()             # Create a new workplane on the selected face
    .center(0.0277, 0.0277)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.01385)         # Draw a smaller circle for the pointed tip
    .cutThruAll()            # Cut through the smaller cylinder to create the pointed tip
)

# Combine the pen body and the pointed tip
r = pen_body.union(tip)

# Display the final model
